p4NNRun.summary: Runs a loaded model once and waits until the inference job finishes.
p4NNRun.returns: Command; check neural status before reading outputs.
prerequisites: Import P4 Neural Networks and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. run neural model: text; library example NN:00000001.

examples.title: Use run neural model …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Runs a loaded model once and waits until the inference job finishes. Command; check neural status before reading outputs. First save load neural model [sine-int8-v1] as model and check model ready; inspect tensor information before writing inputs.

examples.title: Run the built-in sine model
examples.code:
set model to (load neural model [sine-int8-v1])
if (neural model [model] ready?)
  model [model] tensor information
  set model [model] input [1] to [1000] / 1000
  run neural model [model]
  model [model] output [1] times 1000
  unload neural model [model]
examples.explanation: Input 1000 represents 1.0. Output is an approximate scaled model prediction, not an exact math-library result. Check neural status if a request fails.

notes: Local native TFLM reference inference. Builtin catalog: sine-int8-v1. Import compatible static dense TFLite models from the Neural networks editor panel.
